content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Walton Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates need a secondary degree plus several years of direct project-leadership experience. Granite PM Academy advisors can verify your qualifications and identify any gaps before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenario practice. Classes run on a flexible schedule suited to working professionals in the Fort Walton Beach area.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Our team guides you through the online registration process and ensures your documentation meets PMI standards before submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring, then complete your certification assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and continuing-education courses to help you meet PMI renewal requirements and advance your project-management career.
